title: Machine keys
subtitle: A machine key authenticates the local agent installed on one of your machines (brabo-runner running as a service). It is born on the machine, at install time, and only its public half ever reaches here. This lists YOUR machine keys, revoked ones included — and it works with no project yet, which is exactly when the install creates one. Project keys are not here: they live in each project's settings.
subtitleAlcance: A machine key serves every project of yours in runner mode: revoking it drops the local agent in all of them at once.
subtitleNaoEBatimento: A registered key is not a running agent: "last used" is the last time the agent asked for access with it, never proof that it is up right now — what knows about right now is a project's terminal.
subtitleSubstitui: Installing again on the same account registers a new machine key and revokes the previous one; that is why an older revoked key may show up here without anyone having clicked revoke.
naoSei: I couldn't read your machine keys. That doesn't mean there are none — it means I don't know.
emptyMessage: Your account has no machine key. One is created when the Brabo installer sets up the local agent on a machine.
orfa: An active key no local agent has ever used is usually from an install that never got to start the agent — it is inert, but it still works. Revoke it if you don't recognize it.

modal.title: Revoke machine key
modal.body: Revoking “{{name}}” is final: it stops authenticating the local agent on that machine, and getting a new one means installing the agent again.
modal.alcance: It drops the local agent in EVERY project of yours in runner mode, not just one. With no project yet, it only stops the key from being used again.
modal.colateral: Dropping reaches {project, user} and never one particular key: another runner of yours in those projects also falls, even authenticated with a different credential — and reconnects on its own if that credential is still valid.
